extracted.intended_audience: Eligible applicants (typically Country Coordinating Mechanisms), national program stakeholders and Principal Recipients preparing Global Fund funding requests
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and submitting a funding request package to the Global Fund after receiving an allocation, structuring investments, indicating managing Principal Recipients, and aligning proposals with Global Fund frameworks and country priorities so grants are ready for implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design grants ready for implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: The goal of the applying for funding stage is to ultimately design quality grants that are ready for implementation before the current grants end.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan timelines and activities so that approved grants can begin implementation without gaps from existing grants; emphasize readiness and continuity in proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding request purpose and content
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding requests are the package of documents submitted by applicants (typically the Country Coordinating Mechanism) that tell the Global Fund how the allocation funding will be invested into country disease programs and why the requested investments were chosen as a priority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure the package clearly explains proposed investments, rationale/prioritization, and how the funding will be used across disease programs; completeness of the document package is critical.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate Principal Recipients (PRs)
rubrics_metrics.description: When applying for funding, applicants also indicate which Principal Recipients (PRs) will be managing the investments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify designated PR(s) in the request and ensure they are prepared to manage the proposed grants; include justification for PR selection where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structure requests per the Modular Framework (align with WHO guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants will structure their funding requests based on the Global Fund’s Modular Framework which provides standard modules, interventions and performance indicators that are aligned with World Health Organization (WHO) guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Modular Framework’s standard modules, interventions and performance indicators to structure investments and measurable results; align proposed activities with WHO guidance and the Framework templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Option to base request on National Strategic Plan or Payment for Results
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants are also able to base their funding requests on National Strategic Plan priority areas or on a Payment for Results scheme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where appropriate, align investments to national strategic priorities or propose a payment-for-results approach, documenting how chosen approach meets Global Fund objectives and measurement requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide a broad, comprehensive view across disease programs and PRs
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding requests provide a broad look at the investments being requested, often with investments across disease programs and PRs, and are developed by the applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare a comprehensive package that covers all requested investments across diseases and implementing entities, demonstrating coherence and coordination between program components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet application-package-specific requirements (context-dependent)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Global Fund has different funding request expectations depending on country context and the scope of the Global Fund’s investment in a country. These 'funding request application packages' have different requirements and review processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify which application package applies to your country (as specified in allocation communications) and follow that package’s specific documentation, formatting, and review-process requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow allocation letter instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: In their allocation letters, eligible countries receiving an allocation are informed of the allocation amount, which application approach they are asked to use, and other important details.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully adhere to the allocation letter’s stated allocation amount, prescribed application approach, timelines and other stipulations when preparing the funding request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use core applicant guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: To assist applicants in optimizing the available funding, the Global Fund publishes core applicant guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult and apply the Global Fund’s core applicant guidance to optimize the design and use of allocated funds, and to ensure compliance with Global Fund expectations and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Take planning considerations into account
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants will take many planning considerations into account when organizing how they will develop funding requests and turn them into grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage in early planning, stakeholder consultation, sequencing of activities, resourcing, and risk assessment to ensure the request is implementable and transitions into a grant smoothly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Distinguish funding requests from grants (roles and stage differences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding requests are developed by the applicant and provide a broad proposal; grants are a legal agreement between the Global Fund and a single PR, developed through grant-making negotiations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare the funding request as a programmatic proposal for allocation use; anticipate that detailed grant instruments and single-PR legal agreements will follow successful review and negotiation during grant-making.
